summary: As requested by City Council, this report provides a summary of the 2017 activities for the City of Toronto's Program Advisory Bodies. City divisions establish Program Advisory Bodies to provide advice to staff on City policies, programs and initiatives. Program Advisory Bodies are one consultation mechanism that City divisions use to solicit advice and input from key stakeholders, community partners and service users. In 2017, there were a total of sixty-six (66) Program Advisory Bodies. During the same year, nine (9) Program Advisory Bodies completed their mandate and were dissolved, five (5) were recessed and six (6) new Program Advisory Bodies were created.
decided: City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (April 3, 2018) from the Interim City Manager for information. 2. City Council request the City Manager to report directly to the July 23, 24 and 25, 2018 City Council meeting on: a. whether appointments to Program Advisory Bodies are following the same criteria for selection, method of recruitment, selection of members and term of membership as that of the Public Appointments Policy; and b. the length of service of members who serve on these advisory bodies.
